rows.location: course/modules/AC/AC2/L06.html E3 solution (line 457, sentence 'Using the rounded inputs 0.0031 and 0.0015 gives z = 2.067 and a tail of 0.039, which is an artefact of rounding the standard error.')
rows.evidence: The shift from z = 2.096 to 2.067 comes from rounding both inputs, and the two roundings move z in opposite directions (recompute_r5b.out): rounding only the SE gives z = 2.051 (tail 0.040); rounding only the difference gives z = 2.113 (tail 0.035); rounding both gives 2.067 (tail 0.039). Attributing the whole change to the standard error is a cause stated more exactly than the arithmetic supports.
rows.fix: Replace 'which is an artefact of rounding the standard error' with 'which is an artefact of rounding the inputs (rounding the standard error alone gives 2.051, rounding the difference alone gives 2.113)'.

rows.location: course/modules/AC/AC2/L06.html §5 bullet 2 (line 359): 'Lab 1 has no revenue channel, because the planted manipulation enters the discretionary term directly'
rows.evidence: Read literally the claim is false: the lab's total-accrual generator (tests/labs/AC2/lab-AC2-L06-1.py, module docstring and make_sample: total = lag x (C1/lag + C2 (drev - drec)/lag + C3 ppe/lag + DA), with C2 = 0.10 from C_TRUE) puts the revenue-less-receivables term in the true accruals. What the lab lacks is a manipulation that runs through revenue, which is the point the bullet means.
rows.fix: Replace 'Lab 1 has no revenue channel' with 'Lab 1 plants no manipulation through revenue (the revenue-less-receivables term does enter the true accruals, with coefficient 0.10)'.
